test_title: PYST 6: SSC JE EE - Reasoning (Held on: 24 March 2021 (Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven friends A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight line facing north. D is between A and B. C is to the immediate left of E. F is at one of the corners. Two persons are sitting between G and B. C is to the immediate right of B. F is sitting adjacent to A. Who is sitting between C and G?
solution:
As per the given information:

(1) F is at one of the corners and F is sitting adjacent to A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6389d7be8dd25fdcab3354e7f0b2733d62b705423550616e2a1adddb2d2d7b0b.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b46dc45655063e6daebcc9275f8c0999e989891a884c9f43aefd7a6ca0c6850c.png] 

(2) D is between A and B and two persons are sitting between G and B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5dfbd017e83cf41ff6d27c7a87563853c8b98a11797ab9b351e84804d67854d.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b114cb82bf3cc3345486bfa83e7357eb92e6f195df0e8cd35ce3991ba89e87ec.png] 

(3) C is to the immediate left of E and C is to the immediate right of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af121363056534f4ea5b7e19d571632321c7679501cc52afe57632c82d977c15.png] 

Here,** 'E' **is sitting between C and G.

Hence, the correct answer is** "E".**
